stations_forecast.value: Efficient first-stage extraction because named Mobile Bay points can be read without downloading the full grid.

regulargrid.value: Second-stage extraction for cell-specific shoreline-normal currents and nearshore vertical structure.

unstructured_fields.value: Highest-fidelity FVCOM representation; use only where regular-grid interpolation is inadequate.

implementation_phases.name: named_station_guidance
implementation_phases.reason: Fastest reproducible route to time-resolved model state and historical backtesting with much smaller payloads.

implementation_phases.name: shoreline_cell_regulargrid
implementation_phases.reason: Needed for actual shoreline-normal transport rather than broad named-point proxies.

implementation_phases.name: unstructured_sensitivity
implementation_phases.reason: Use only if regular-grid interpolation materially changes nearshore conclusions or resolves wet/dry/geometry issues.

science_calibration_hypotheses.hypothesis: Offshore upwelling can advect colder, saltier, lower-DO water into Mobile Bay; transport and stratification state should interact rather than enter as independent simple weights.
science_calibration_hypotheses.published_reference_feature: Strong upwelling periods in their analysis used a 4-day mean offshore surface transport threshold >0.005 m2/s plus an 11-hour lag.

science_calibration_hypotheses.hypothesis: A strong wind/mixing event can reduce stratification and reoxygenate bottom water; the model needs both transport-favorable and mixing-destruction terms.

required_extractor_behavior: Cache downloaded or queried source payloads by cryptographic hash/request identity.
Record model initialization time, forecast valid time, available_at and ingested_at separately.
Preserve surface versus depth-resolved fields; do not label model salinity/current as direct observation.
For shoreline cells, extract a local neighborhood and compute shoreline-normal and shoreline-parallel vector components from documented shoreline orientation.
Retain source station/grid coordinates, depth interpretation, model cycle and forecast lead.
Do not use forecast fields that were not available at the historical target time in retrospective validation.
Backtest against confirmed events and observation-effort matched controls before assigning positive production weight.
guardrail: NGOFS2 is model guidance. It must remain distinct from CO-OPS observations, direct current meters and local bottom sensors; published upwelling thresholds are physical hypotheses, not pre-validated Jubilee thresholds.
